Method of Attack: Email spam botnet used to deploy second-stage malware payloads
Deployment of ransomware payloads on infected systems
Untethering victim computers from the botnet to prevent additional malware installation
Use of command and control servers to control infected devices
Full network compromise via TA542 threat group
Use of ProxyLogon exploits to compromise Microsoft Exchange servers
Discoverer: Law enforcement agencies including Bundeskriminalamt (BKA), Europol, FBI
Malwarebytes security researchers Jérôme Segura and Hasherezade
Impacted Systems: Computers compromised by QBot and Trickbot
US-based Microsoft Exchange servers compromised using ProxyLogon exploits
Devices infected by BADBOX 2.0 Android malware
Indicators of Compromise: EmotetLoader.dll (32-bit module used to uninstall Emotet)
Command and control servers controlled by Bundeskriminalamt
Communication parameters adjusted to redirect victim systems to law enforcement infrastructure
